description: Quantify packing between the YIL164C-equivalent and YIL165C-equivalent halves in the intact Lachancea Nit1-branch ortholog model, including catalytic triad proximity to the C-terminal segment
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
p="/agent/jobs/6da7974d-8050-41f7-bb23-602b12e418f7/provenance/AF-C5DH06.pdb"
atoms=[]
for ln in open(p):
    if ln.startswith("ATOM"):
        atoms.append((int(ln[22:26]), ln[17:20].strip(), ln[12:16].strip(),
                      float(ln[30:38]),float(ln[38:46]),float(ln[46:54])))
A=pd.DataFrame(atoms,columns=["res","aa","atom","x","y","z"])
print("Lachancea C5DH06 model: residues", A.res.min(), "-", A.res.max(), "| atoms", len(A))

# Map S. cerevisiae positions onto C5DH06 using the phenix global alignment shown above:
# fixed (C5DH06) has an extra Met at position 1, so Sc position i ~ Lt position i+1.
SPLIT_LT = 201   # Sc W200 -> Lt 201
N = A[A.res< SPLIT_LT]; C = A[A.res>=SPLIT_LT]
print(f"N-segment (Lt 1-{SPLIT_LT-1}, = YIL164C part): {N.res.nunique()} residues")
print(f"C-segment (Lt {SPLIT_LT}-{A.res.max()}, = YIL165C part): {C.res.nunique()} residues")

Nc=N[["x","y","z"]].to_numpy(); Cc=C[["x","y","z"]].to_numpy()
d=np.sqrt(((Nc[:,None,:]-Cc[None,:,:])**2).sum(-1))
pairs=np.argwhere(d<5.0)
nres=set(N.res.to_numpy()[pairs[:,0]]); cres=set(C.res.to_numpy()[pairs[:,1]])
print(f"\nHeavy-atom contacts <5 A between the two segments: {len(pairs)}")
print(f"  N-segment residues contacting C-segment: {len(nres)} ({100*len(nres)/N.res.nunique():.0f}% of the segment)")
print(f"  C-segment residues contacting N-segment: {len(cres)} ({100*len(cres)/C.res.nunique():.0f}% of the segment)")

# contacts of the catalytic triad (Sc E44,K135,C169 -> Lt 45,136,170) with the C-segment
print("\nCatalytic triad contacts with the C-terminal segment (<8 A, heavy atoms):")
for sc_pos, lt_pos, lab in [(44,45,'Glu44'),(135,136,'Lys135'),(169,170,'Cys169')]:
    t=A[A.res==lt_pos]
    print(f"   Lt residue {lt_pos} ({t.aa.iloc[0]}) <- Sc {lab}")
    tc=t[["x","y","z"]].to_numpy()
    dd=np.sqrt(((tc[:,None,:]-Cc[None,:,:])**2).sum(-1))
    close=C.res.to_numpy()[np.argwhere(dd<8.0)[:,1]]
    print(f"      C-segment residues within 8 A: {sorted(set(close))}  (n={len(set(close))}), min dist {dd.min():.2f} A")

# per-residue contact profile figure
prof=np.zeros(A.res.max()+1)
for i,jj in pairs:
    prof[N.res.to_numpy()[i]]+=1; prof[C.res.to_numpy()[jj]]+=1
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(11,3.4))
x=np.arange(1,A.res.max()+1)
ax.bar(x[x<SPLIT_LT], prof[1:SPLIT_LT], color='#4C78A8', width=1.0, label='N segment (YIL164C part)')
ax.bar(x[x>=SPLIT_LT], prof[SPLIT_LT:], color='#72B7B2', width=1.0, label='C segment (YIL165C part)')
ax.axvline(SPLIT_LT-0.5, color='#D62728', lw=1.4)
ax.text(SPLIT_LT+3, ax.get_ylim()[1]*0.9, 'site of the S288C TAG\n(Trp200 in S. cerevisiae)', color='#D62728', fontsize=9, va='top')
for sc_pos, lt_pos, lab in [(44,45,'Glu44'),(135,136,'Lys135'),(169,170,'Cys169')]:
    ax.plot(lt_pos, -1.2, marker='^', color='#54278F', ms=7, clip_on=False)
    ax.text(lt_pos, -4.2, lab, ha='center', fontsize=8, color='#54278F')
ax.set_xlabel('residue in Lachancea thermotolerans C5DH06 (intact 323-aa Nit1-branch ortholog)')
ax.set_ylabel('inter-segment\nheavy-atom contacts <5 Å')
ax.set_title('Packing between the YIL164C-equivalent and YIL165C-equivalent halves of the intact fold', fontsize=11)
ax.legend(fontsize=8, frameon=False); ax.set_xlim(0, A.res.max()+1)
for sp in ['top','right']: ax.spines[sp].set_visible(False)
plt.show()
